name: Mission Vision Writing
description: Produces mission and vision statements using strategic communications formulas, with a present-focused mission statement and a future-focused vision statement tailored to the organization's purpose and aspirations. Use when the user asks to write or refine a mission statement, create a vision statement, define organizational purpose, or articulate company direction for stakeholders. Do NOT use for brand positioning statement (use brand-positioning), value proposition for customers (use value-proposition), or full business plan (use business-plan).
